posts.title: The multiplier effect: How authoring tools can transform web accessibility
posts.description: In this post, W3C's Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) Director Shawn Lawton Henry covers how authoring tools can help make vast amounts of content more accessible with less effort.

posts.title: W3C Newsletter - October 2026
posts.description: W3C President and Interim CEO Dominique Hazaël-Massieux shares timely and notable highlights and information selected from the busy and prolific work last month at W3C such as TPAC 2026, AI @ W3C, progress on Identity and Credentials, further improvements to W3C infrastructure for standardization and more.

posts.title: Historical www-talk archives made complete
posts.description: W3C's archives of the www-talk mailing list are now complete, back to its creation in October 1991. This post lists some of the more interesting messages in the early development of the Web.
